_class_why: 0 patch sites; its entire content is an `imports` edit adding an mh.dll descriptor to the target FILE. The fork loads the DLL through the msvfw32 proxy instead.
_comment: IMPORT-ONLY patch for the determinism replay harness (docs/mp-replay-harness.md, tasks/mp-restoration.md Step 0). Adds the mh.dll import to a stock mh.exe with NO code patches, so DllMain runs and MH_Harness_Init arms the harness when mh_net.ini beside the exe carries `[harness] enable=1` (fork F2G merged the old mh_harness.ini into it; a leftover copy of that file is REFUSED). Deliberately vanilla: no pool relocation, so the sim runs exactly as retail and the per-step state hash reads projectile_pool at its stock .bss VA (0x00e1db98). Run: python mhpatch.py apply mh.exe harness_load.mh.patch.json mh.harness.exe   (then drop mh.dll + mh_net.ini beside mh.harness.exe).
